name: Ownership Pattern Validation
description: Validate ownership patterns in function parameters and return values.

options.label: Borrowed Immutable Parameter (Good)
options.conditions: structure == FnDecl && ownership_mode == Borrowed && mutability == Immutable
options.explanation: Function takes immutable reference — efficient and safe.

options.label: Owned Parameter (Acceptable)
options.explanation: Function takes ownership of parameter — caller cannot reuse value.

options.label: Borrowed Mutable Parameter (Warning)
options.conditions: structure == FnDecl && ownership_mode == Borrowed && mutability == Mutable
options.explanation: Function takes mutable reference — caller cannot use value during call.

options.label: Not a Function Declaration
options.explanation: Ownership pattern validation only applies to function declarations.
